verdict.rationale: The docs say the `tofu import` command imports existing resources into OpenTofu, and a community user notes that import blocks support for_each. That covers bringing existing resources under management. Nothing in the evidence shows OpenTofu generating matching configuration code for imported resources, so only half the story is supported. Missing for 10: any evidence of automatic configuration generation for imported resources, in-depth import workflow docs, and hands-on corroboration of the import-to-code workflow.
